an7.645-1124:1.7: issāya → T. imassā; M6. M7 issā. (pts note)
an7.645-1124:2.1: Idam → these two phrases are missing in S. (pts note)
an7.645-1124:2.2: ti → Ph. adds: Saṅkavarena (sic) niyato chaṭhamā saṁkhittena ca. Then: <vi> rāgānupassī viharati paṭinissaggānupassī viharatī ti. Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya, as above. Katame satta? Satisaṁbojjhaṅgo dhammavicayasaṁbojjhaṅgo viriyasaṁbojjhaṅgo pithi- (sic) passaddhi- samādhi- upekkhā-. Rāgassa bh- abhiññāya ime satta dh- bh- ti. Rāgassa bh- abhi- satta dh- bh-. Katame satta? Aniccasaññā, anatta- and so on, as above, till the end. (pts note) | Sattakanipāto → M. Ph. sattanipātaṁ; T. M6. M7 sattako. (pts note)
an7.645-1124:2.3: niṭṭhitaṁ → rāgapadato paṭṭhāya pamādapadapariyattesu sattarassu padesu ekamekaṁ abhiññāyādidasapadehi yojetvā satta dhammā bhāvetabbā’ti niddiṭṭhehi tīhi sattabojjhaṅga (bj: satta aniccasaññādi - satta asubhasaññādi suttehi paccekaṁ ghaṭitāni sabbasuttati dasādhika pañcasatāni honti.) | samatto → M. Ph. samattaṁ; S. niṭṭhito; M7 adds siddhir astu, sivam astu, jayatu. (pts note) | Namo → T. omits this udāna. (pts note)
an7.645-1124:2.4: I → S. has Paṇṇāsako; the other MSS. have no title at all. (pts note)
